# AMD ADLX SDK subset

Unmodified headers, helper and Windows loader from AMD's official repository:
https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/ADLX

Downloaded 2026-09-27 from the main branch archive. Archive SHA256:
`F05601D7F231C29782EF6C525E13C1046EAF902380560DE47110D2E69D09192F`.

Only the dependencies needed for performance monitoring are included. Original
copyright notices and the upstream ADLX SDK License Agreement are retained.
No driver DLL is redistributed. At runtime the installed AMD driver provides it.
